chorus_1.lyrics: They said I didn't have what it takes. I needed money and a pretty face. But I just look at them and say, I use what I got, take what I get, give till I ain't got nothing left, then I give it some more. Keep on climbing up that mountain, keep trucking along, work up a sweat, past every no after no after no till I get a yes. I don't worry about what I'm not.
